pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with rounded vertices. Patch area is significantly larger on the mid-flank and decreases in scale towards the posterior and lower extremities. Edges show moderate pixel-gradient transitions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes are primarily trivalent or tetravalent. Pathway thickness is wider on the mid-flank and narrows into a tighter grid toward the hindquarters.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged contour along the dorsal neck ridge.
